diagnosis: The CI/CD deployment trace endpoint resolves build span attributes by deploymentSpanId without checking user repository permissions. The span attributes contain internal Docker registry image digests, commit SHAs, and staging environment variables, allowing developers from other projects to view private deployment configurations.
exploit_request:
GET /api/traces/deployments/span_deploy_core_banking_9921 HTTP/1.1
Host: cicd.cloud.internal:4043
Authorization: Bearer <unrelated_developer_token>
Accept: application/json
